objectives.en: Write the equation for change in population density
Explain exponential growth and the intrinsic rate of natural increase

narration.en: Darwin calculated that even slow-breeding elephants would, with no checks, cover the Earth in a few centuries. With unlimited resources every population shoots up like the letter J.
narration.kn: ಯಾವುದೇ ತಡೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಆನೆಗಳೂ ಕೆಲವು ಶತಮಾನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ತುಂಬುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಡಾರ್ವಿನ್ ಲೆಕ್ಕಹಾಕಿದರು. ಅಪರಿಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲವಿದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಮಷ್ಟಿಯೂ J ಅಕ್ಷರದಂತೆ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Population size changes with food availability, predation pressure and adverse weather. Four basic processes change density: natality (B), the number of births during a given period that are added to the initial density; mortality (D), the number of deaths; immigration (I), individuals of the same species coming into the habitat from elsewhere; and emigration (E), individuals leaving the habitat. Natality and immigration increase density; mortality and emigration decrease it. If N is the density at time t, the density at time t + 1 is given below. Under normal conditions births and deaths are the most important factors; immigration and emigration matter only under special conditions, for example when a new habitat is being colonised.

points.en: Births and deaths usually matter most

narration.en: Population density rises with births and immigration, and falls with deaths and emigration: N at t plus one equals N at t plus births plus immigrants, minus deaths and emigrants.
narration.kn: ಜನನ ಮತ್ತು ವಲಸೆ ಬರುವಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಸಮಷ್ಟಿ ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ, ಮರಣ ಮತ್ತು ವಲಸೆ ಹೋಗುವಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: N(t+1) = N(t) + (B + I) − (D + E).

title.en: Board: what makes a population grow

say.en: Four processes change a population: natality and immigration add individuals; mortality and emigration remove them.
So next year’s population is this year’s plus births and immigrants, minus deaths and emigrants. For 500 deer: 500 plus 70 minus 60 gives 510.
With unlimited food and space, the rate of growth is proportional to the population itself. That is exponential growth, with r equal to birth rate minus death rate.
Plotted against time, it rises slowly and then shoots up: a J-shaped curve.
Bacteria with r equal to 0.693 per hour double every hour, so 1000 cells become 8000 in three hours.

narration.en: Four processes change a population: natality and immigration add individuals; mortality and emigration remove them. So next year’s population is this year’s plus births and immigrants, minus deaths and emigrants. For 500 deer: 500 plus 70 minus 60 gives 510. With unlimited food and space, the rate of growth is proportional to the population itself. That is exponential growth, with r equal to birth rate minus death rate. Plotted against time, it rises slowly and then shoots up: a J-shaped curve. Bacteria with r equal to 0.693 per hour double every hour, so 1000 cells become 8000 in three hours.

body.en: When resources (food and space) are unlimited, each species can realise fully its innate potential to grow in number, as Darwin observed. Population growth is then exponential (geometric). If b is the per capita birth rate and d the per capita death rate in a population of size N, the rate of change is dN/dt = (b − d)N. Writing r = b − d gives dN/dt = rN. Here r is the intrinsic rate of natural increase, a very important parameter for judging the impact of biotic or abiotic factors on growth. Examples of r: Norway rat 0.015, flour beetle 0.12; for the human population of India in 1981, r was 0.0205. Integrated, the equation gives N$_t$ = N$_0$e$^{rt}$, where e is the base of natural logarithms (2.71828). Plotting N against time gives a J-shaped curve.

points.en: r = b − d: intrinsic rate of natural increase
Norway rat r = 0.015; flour beetle r = 0.12; India 1981 r = 0.0205

narration.en: With unlimited resources, a population grows exponentially: dN by dt equals rN, where r, the intrinsic rate of natural increase, is birth rate minus death rate. The size follows N equals N zero times e to the rt, a J-shaped curve.
narration.kn: ಅಪರಿಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲವಿದ್ದಾಗ ಸಮಷ್ಟಿ ಘಾತೀಯವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ: dN/dt = rN; ಇಲ್ಲಿ r ಸ್ವಾಭಾವಿಕ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ದರ, ಅಂದರೆ ಜನನ ದರ ಮೈನಸ್ ಮರಣ ದರ. ಗಾತ್ರ N = N₀e^{rt} ಆಗಿ J-ಆಕಾರದ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A bacterial culture starts with 1,000 cells and grows exponentially with r = 0.693 per hour. How many cells are there after 3 hours? (e^2.079 ≈ 8)

answer.en: About 8,000 cells (the population doubles every hour).
